title: Topological Recursion on Spectral Curves with Infinite Ramification Loci
summary: Recently in the physics literature there have been a small, but growing, number of papers that have applied the Eynard-Orantin topological recursion procedure to spectral curves with ramification loci of infinite cardinality. However, there is a corresponding gap in the mathematics literature; indeed, it has not been checked rigorously whether the resulting infinite sums converge, or whether the resulting correlators have all the desired properties of the topological recursion.
